Tiraspol.question: The _____ was Capital and largest city of Transnistria, a breakaway state of Moldova.
Tiraspol.fact: Tiraspol (Romanian pronunciation: [tiˈraspol], Moldovan Cyrillic: Тираспол; also Tirișpolea, Тиришполя; Russian: Тирасполь, romanized: Tiraspol', [tʲɪˈraspəlʲ]; Ukrainian: Тирасполь, romanized: Tyraspol', [tɪˈrɑspolʲ]) is the capital and largest city of Transnistria, a breakaway state of Moldova, where it is the second-largest city.
